trainer/30189-noteach.htm.text: Priest Rovia: I have nothing to teach you. You must find another teacher, someone who suits you better. Or perhaps you would prefer to say and chat with me a bit longer? Oh, sorry, someone is comming. Please come again...

Q10279_MutatedKaneusOren/30189-02.htm.text: Magister Rovia: This is it. Tissue samples of the mutated Kaneus! Now we can move forward with our study about the mutated Kaneus and the nature of Kamaloka. Soon we will discover their underlying nature! This is only the beginning of a long journey to find the truth.

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
